title: Privacy Notice Provisioning
description: The Data Fiduciary shall provide a privacy notice to the Data Principal before or at the time of requesting consent for processing personal data.

actions.title: Identify Personal Data Collection Channels
actions.description: Identify all websites, applications, portals, forms, APIs, call centers, kiosks, and other channels through which personal data is collected.

actions.title: Inventory Personal Data Collection Activities
actions.description: Maintain an inventory of all business processes that collect personal data from Data Principals.

actions.title: Determine Notice Applicability
actions.description: Assess which collection channels and processing activities require a privacy notice under DPDP requirements.

actions.title: Draft Privacy Notice Content
actions.description: Prepare a privacy notice containing all information required under the DPDP Act and Rules.

actions.title: Review Notice for Legal Compliance
actions.description: Validate that the privacy notice satisfies all applicable statutory requirements.

actions.title: Obtain Internal Approval
actions.description: Obtain approval of the privacy notice from authorized stakeholders.

actions.title: Publish Notice at Collection Points
actions.description: Make the privacy notice available before or at the time personal data is collected.

actions.title: Integrate Notice with Consent Mechanisms
actions.description: Ensure the privacy notice is linked or displayed alongside consent collection interfaces.

actions.title: Validate Notice Availability
actions.description: Verify that Data Principals can access the privacy notice from all applicable collection channels.

actions.title: Maintain Notice Repository
actions.description: Store approved versions of privacy notices in a centralized repository.

actions.title: Monitor Processing Changes
actions.description: Review whether new processing activities require updates to the privacy notice.

actions.title: Periodically Review Notice Effectiveness
actions.description: Conduct periodic reviews to ensure notices remain accurate and aligned with actual processing activities.

title: Notice Accessibility Management
description: The Data Fiduciary shall ensure that notices are easily accessible, understandable, and available to Data Principals through appropriate channels.

title: Purpose Disclosure Management
description: The notice must be delivered to the Data Principal before or at the same time as the consent request is made. Delivering a notice after consent has been captured — or making consent collection the first user interaction — renders the consent legally invalid.

title: Rights Information Disclosure
description: The Data Fiduciary shall inform Data Principals of their rights under the Act and the means available for exercising those rights.

title: Grievance Information Disclosure
description: The Data Fiduciary shall provide details of grievance redressal mechanisms available to Data Principals.

title: Notice Delivery for Existing Personal Data
description: Where personal data was collected prior to commencement of the Act, the Data Fiduciary shall provide notice to existing Data Principals as required by law.

title: Personal Data Categories Disclosure
description: The notice shall specify the categories and items of personal data proposed to be processed.

title: Processing Purpose Specification
description: The notice shall provide an itemized description of each processing purpose associated with personal data collection

title: Consent Withdrawal Information
description: The notice shall clearly describe the process available for withdrawal of consent.

title: Rights Exercise Information
description: The notice shall provide information regarding methods available for exercising Data Principal rights.

title: Complaint Escalation Information
description: The notice shall inform Data Principals regarding their right to approach the Data Protection Board after exhausting grievance mechanisms.

title: Multilingual Notice Support
description: The notice shall be made available in English and/or languages specified under applicable requirements to ensure comprehension by Data Principals.

title: Notice Version Governance
description: The organization shall maintain governance mechanisms to ensure notices remain current, accurate, and aligned with processing activities.
